opencv_haar.scope: Fixed windows from a real photograph. Pillow RGB-to-L and bilinear resizing to 24x24 precede the cascade evaluation. The trace covers the OpenCV variance gate and evaluated stages for each window.
opencv_haar.stage_cutoff_rule: Reject if sum of selected leaf scores is below the float32 stored stage threshold minus 1e-5, as in OpenCV 4.12.0.

langid.scope: UTF-8 byte counts from the checkpoint's DFA, then log evidence, class priors, and argmax across all 97 classes. The listed probabilities use optional normalization across the full class set.
langid.class_prior_parameterization: The stored prior term is the natural logarithm of the class document count. The training implementation in langid/train/NBtrain.py leaves the common prior normalizer out of the stored term.
langid.decision_rule: Choose the highest stored class prior term plus the sum of active byte-feature counts times learned log likelihoods.

vmaf_svr.model: Netflix VMAF v0.6.1 LIBSVM RBF nu-support vector regression
vmaf_svr.scope: Full support-vector regression over six published per-frame video features, including the default HDTV score clipping.

published_distorted_frame_0.source_description: Frame 0 from the published libvmaf CLI comparison of src01_hrc00_576x324.yuv and src01_hrc01_576x324.yuv. The feature inputs are printed to six decimal places.

identical_reference_frame_0.source_description: Frame 0 of src01_hrc00_576x324.yuv compared with itself in the issue's libvmaf log. Motion is zero and the other features are close to one.

identical_reference_frame_1.source_description: Frame 1 of the same identical-clips log, with positive motion. The score activates the upper clipping bound.
